dedupe_keys.name: ifsgrid geospatial data from the 2020 eu agricultural census eurostat

description: IFSGRID is the gridded geospatial release of the 2020 agricultural census of the European Union. The Zenodo record says the census geolocates each farm by its main buildings, main activity or nearest village, and IFSGRID holds 18 files for the contextual indicators of the Common Agricultural Policy monitoring framework, covering holdings, land use, livestock, labour input, age, gender, skills and organic farming. It was published in February 2025 by the Statistical Office of the European Communities (Eurostat) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 76 MB, with a methodological note. Coverage is the EU. Caveats: the grid size and confidentiality rules are in the methodological note, not stated on the page read, and values are census aggregates per cell. For simulation it gives the spatial pattern of farms, livestock and farm labour to model agricultural exposure to hazards and rural supply chains. Related catalogue records include the harmonized IACS inventory and the UK Farm Business Survey.
